BESS System & Project Engineering

**The Opportunity**
The role will support the
**system engineering, sizing and technical integration of Battery Energy Storage System solutions**
for tenders and customer-specific projects, from requirements analysis and concept development through detailed engineering, testing and commissioning.
  
  
The successful candidate will work across Electrical, Mechanical and Controls Engineering to integrate batteries, BMS, PCS, transformers, LV/MV systems, EMS/PPC/SCADA, thermal management, fire-protection and auxiliary systems into safe, compliant and cost-effective BESS solutions.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
The System Engineer will execute assigned
**system engineering and integration activities**
for BESS projects under the guidance of Senior/Lead Engineers.
  
  
The position will support customer-requirement analysis, BESS sizing and configuration, system specifications, interface management, technical compliance and verification activities.
  
  
The engineer will work closely with Electrical, Mechanical and Controls Engineering and interface with Tendering, Procurement, Project Management, Testing, Commissioning and equipment suppliers.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Tender & Solution Engineering
* Review customer specifications, tender documents and technical requirements.
* Support translation of customer requirements into system-level engineering requirements.
* Assist in developing BESS configurations and preliminary solution concepts.
* Support BESS power and energy sizing based on application requirements.
* Identify technical requirements, assumptions, deviations and clarification points.
* Support preparation of technical proposals and compliance matrices.
* Provide system-engineering inputs for technical and cost evaluation of alternative solutions.
* System Engineering & BESS Sizing

**Perform And Support System-engineering Activities Covering**

* BESS power and energy sizing
* Battery and PCS configuration
* System operating requirements
* Efficiency and auxiliary consumption
* Environmental and site requirements
* Availability and redundancy requirements
* System configuration and equipment ratings
* Preliminary performance evaluation

Support evaluation of system configurations based on customer requirements, performance, cost and project constraints.
  
  

* Requirements & Technical Compliance
* Capture and maintain customer and system-level requirements.
* Support preparation of system specifications and design-basis documents.
* Maintain requirements and technical compliance matrices.
* Coordinate requirements with Electrical, Mechanical and Controls Engineering.
* Support identification and resolution of requirement gaps and technical deviations.
* Assist in maintaining traceability between customer requirements, engineering solutions and verification activities.
* System Integration & Interface Management

**Support Integration Across The Major BESS Subsystems**
**Battery/BMS ↔ PCS ↔ Electrical System ↔ EMS/PPC/SCADA ↔ Grid/Customer Interface**

* Coordinate interfaces between Electrical, Mechanical and Controls disciplines.
* Support interfaces with HVAC, fire-protection, auxiliary and site systems.
* Maintain interface specifications and interface-related documentation.
* Identify interface gaps, conflicts and inconsistencies and coordinate their resolution.
* Support technical coordination with equipment and subsystem suppliers.
* Participate in multidisciplinary design reviews.
* Standards, Safety & Design-to-Cost
* Apply applicable BESS standards, customer requirements, grid requirements and project specifications.
* Support technical compliance reviews across major BESS subsystems.
* Participate in system safety, technical-risk and design reviews.
* Support use of standard BESS architectures, configurations and proven solutions.
* Assist in technical comparison of alternative components and subsystems.
* Consider system performance, cost, reliability and maintainability during engineering decisions.
* System Verification, Testing & Commissioning

* Assist in preparation of system test plans and acceptance criteria.
* Support subsystem and integrated-system Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT).
* Verify system functions and interfaces against project requirements.
* Support Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), commissioning and performance testing.
* Assist in investigation and resolution of cross-disciplinary technical issues.
* Capture test results and support closure of system requirements.

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Power Electronics, Energy Systems, Control Engineering or a closely related discipline.

**Experience**

* 3–7 years of relevant system, electrical, power or multidisciplinary engineering experience.

* Experience or exposure to BESS sizing, configuration and system integration.
* Understanding of major BESS subsystems including battery/BMS, PCS, transformer/MV system and EMS/PPC/SCADA.

* Experience preparing system specifications, compliance matrices or interface documentation.
* Experience working across multiple engineering disciplines.
* Exposure to FAT, SAT, commissioning and system verification.

Experience in

* MATLAB/Simulink for system modelling, calculations and performance analysis
* ETAP / DIgSILENT PowerFactory or equivalent for understanding and reviewing power-system studies

Master's Degree

title: Transformation Associate
description:
**WE'RE LOOKING FOR A STRATEGIC THINKER.**

Someone who is naturally curious, intellectually restless and thinks beyond the obvious.

At tbp, we work with Founders and Leaders to transform businesses by developing the intelligence, capabilities and systems needed for their next stage of evolution. • A strategic mind - You naturally question, analyse and connect ideas.

• You can look beyond immediate information to recognise patterns and possibilities.

• You are curious about how people think, how businesses work and how organisations evolve.

• You enjoy exploring questions rather than rushing towards easy answers.

•

• You are curious about AI agents and how they can extend human capabilities.

• You understand that AI needs human judgement, not blind dependence.

•
**The attitude to learn and grow**
- You are open to developing strategic and brand-centric thinking.

• You communicate clearly and can articulate your observations.

• You take responsibility for your work and follow through.

• You are comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with the TBP leadership team.

• Support TBP's strategic engagements through research, analysis and structured thinking.

• Use AI as an intelligent working partner for exploring ideas, interpreting information and developing insights.

• Assist in preparing strategic observations and inputs for internal discussions.

• Work closely with TBP leadership on client-related strategic assignments.

• Contribute to improving the quality of our thinking, analysis and execution.

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

This is an opportunity to develop capabilities that go beyond a conventional entry-level job. You will gain exposure to:

• Strategic thinking and its practical application.

• Brand-centric thinking and Brand Constitution.

• Founder-to-System Transformation.

• The relationship between intelligence, leadership, culture and organisational development.

• Advanced applications of AI, prompting and agentic workflows.

You don't need to arrive knowing all of this. The willingness and ability to learn are essential.

**WHO CAN APPLY?**

• Fresh graduates and final-year students who can commit to the role.

• Candidates from any academic discipline.

• Individuals with 0–1 year of experience.

• People who are naturally curious, analytical and comfortable exploring unfamiliar ideas.

• Individuals who enjoy using AI and are keen to explore its possibilities.

**Prior experience in consulting, branding or business transformation is not required.**

**POSITION DETAILS**

• Position: Transformation Associate

• Location: Kochi, Kerala

• Work arrangement: Full-time, work from office

• Working days: Six days a week

• Initial training: Three months

• Probation: Six months

**THIS IS AN OPPORTUNITY TO DEVELOP YOUR THINKING.**

At tbp, we believe the ability to think strategically is not merely a qualification. It is a capability that can be continuously developed. We will help you develop a deeper understanding of businesses, strengthen your strategic capabilities and learn to apply brand-centric thinking to real-world transformation challenges. If you have a curious mind, a natural inclination to think deeply and an instinctive comfort with AI, we would like to meet you.

**Don't just look for a job. Look for an opportunity to expand the way you think.**

**Apply to join tbp.**
